chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: How the old Apex became the Alabam, and the new Apex closed
summary: Mrs. Howard says Italian owners turned the first Apex into the Alabam and the new Apex closed after a killing there.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: For a show with all of those stars. It's amazing. It's amazing today, anyway. So that was the date that the Apex moved from -- or what, there hadn't been an Apex for awhile, is that right? And then one opened on 55th? But there had been one before, further north on Central?
Oh, yes, yes, it was larger than this one, and that's where the Alabam was. You see, after the Apex closed there, then these Italians took it over and named it the Alabam.

Oh, I see, that's how the -- Marshall Royal told me their names, the names of the Italian brothers who had it. I can't remember what their names were. But -- so they -- he didn't seem to know whether they were involved at the same time Moseby was or not, but --
-- when Moseby left there to go south and open a new Apex then, that was when they took the Alabam.
I see. So how long was this one open, the Apex down on 55th?
Well, I don't think we were there over a month, because this fellow got killed up there.
You said it was a maintenance man at the club, got killed there? Then did the club close after that?
Yes, it did. Not right away, not right away. There was something in here about that. Oh, I guess it was in a --
